description:
crates.io uses `categories` and `keywords` for search and category browsing. The 7 RFC-aligned data type crates have them (mail-types, chat-types, contacts-types, calendars-types, tasks-types, filenode-types, sharing-types — all use `categories = ["encoding", "network-programming"]`).

Missing on 18 crates:
- crate-jmap-types
- crate-jmap-mime
- crate-jmap-server
- crate-jmap-mail-server, jmap-chat-server, jmap-contacts-server, jmap-calendars-server, jmap-tasks-server, jmap-filenode-server, jmap-sharing-server (7 server crates)
- crate-jmap-base-client
- crate-jmap-mail-client, jmap-chat-client, jmap-contacts-client, jmap-calendars-client, jmap-tasks-client, jmap-filenode-client, jmap-sharing-client (7 client crates)

Suggested values per role:
- foundation/types: categories=["encoding","network-programming"], keywords=["jmap","rfc8620","types"]
- *-server: categories=["network-programming","web-programming"], keywords=["jmap","<rfc>","server","<topic>"]
- *-client: categories=["network-programming","asynchronous","api-bindings"], keywords=["jmap","<rfc>","client","<topic>"]

crates.io has a max of 5 keywords and 5 categories. Pick from the published list at https://crates.io/category_slugs.
title: P2: 18 of 25 crates missing categories and keywords
